最后，让我们实现组件的JS逻辑：

---

```diff
- 
+ Component({
+   /**
+    * 组件的属性列表
+    */
+   properties: {
+     // 任务类型（决定是否显示时间选择器）
+     taskType: {
+       type: String,
+       value: ''
+     },
+     // 选中的日期数组
+     selectedDates: {
+       type: Array,
+       value: [],
+       observer: function(newVal) {
+         if (newVal && newVal.length > 0) {
+           // 当外部传入选中日期时，更新内部状态
+           this._updateInternalState(newVal);
+         }
+       }
+     },
+     // 开始时间（学习任务）
+     startTime: {
+       type: String,
+       value: ''
+     },
+     // 结束时间（学习任务）
+     endTime: {
+       type: String,
+       value: ''
+     },
+     // 最早可选日期
+     minDate: {
+       type: String,
+       value: ''
+     },
+     // 默认显示月份
+     defaultMonth: {
+       type: String,
+       value: ''
+     }
+   },
+ 
+   /**
+    * 组件的初始数据
+    */
+   data: {
+     // 当前视图月份
+     currentMonth: 1,
+     // 当前视图年份
+     currentYear: 2025,
+     // 日历数据（二维数组，表示日历网格）
+     calendarDays: [],
+     // 选中的日期范围（开始和结束日期）
+     dateRange: {
+       start: '',
+       end: ''
+     },
+     // 选中的日期（数组形式）
+     selectedDatesInternal: [],
+     // 是否正在选择范围（拖动模式）
+     isSelectingRange: false,
+     // 所选周期模式
+     cycleMode: 'none', // 'none', 'daily', 'weekly', 'workdays', 'custom'
+     // 快捷选择项
+     quickOption: '', // 'today', 'tomorrow', 'thisWeek', 'thisMonth', 'custom'
+     // 对所有选中日期使用相同时间
+     useSameTime: true,
+     // 今天的日期字符串 yyyy-MM-dd
+     today: ''
+   },
+ 
+   /**
+    * 组件的方法列表
+    */
+   methods: {
+     /**
+      * 初始化日历数据
+      */
+     initCalendar: function() {
+       // 如果有默认月份，使用默认月份；否则使用当前月份
+       let date = new Date();
+       if (this.data.defaultMonth) {
+         const [year, month] = this.data.defaultMonth.split('-').map(Number);
+         date = new Date(year, month - 1, 1);
+       }
+ 
+       const year = date.getFullYear();
+       const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
+       
+       this.setData({
+         currentYear: year,
+         currentMonth: month,
+         today: this.formatDate(new Date())
+       });
+       
+       this.generateCalendarDays(year, month);
+     },
+     
+     /**
+      * 生成日历网格数据
+      */
+     generateCalendarDays: function(year, month) {
+       const days = [];
+       const firstDay = new Date(year, month - 1, 1);
+       const lastDay = new Date(year, month, 0);
+       
+       // 获取该月第一天是星期几
+       const firstDayOfWeek = firstDay.getDay();
+       // 获取该月的总天数
+       const daysInMonth = lastDay.getDate();
+       
+       // 创建日历网格（6行7列）
+       let week = [];
+       let dayCount = 1;
+       
+       // 上个月的日期填充
+       for (let i = 0; i < firstDayOfWeek; i++) {
+         const prevMonthLastDay = new Date(year, month - 1, 0).getDate();
+         const day = prevMonthLastDay - firstDayOfWeek + i + 1;
+         const prevMonth = month - 1 > 0 ? month - 1 : 12;
+         const prevYear = month - 1 > 0 ? year : year - 1;
+         const dateString = this.formatDate(new Date(prevYear, prevMonth - 1, day));
+         
+         week.push({
+           day: day,
+           date: new Date(prevYear, prevMonth - 1, day),
+           dateString: dateString,
+           isCurrentMonth: false,
+           isToday: dateString === this.data.today,
+           isSelected: this.isDateSelected(dateString),
+           isInRange: this.isDateInRange(dateString)
+         });
+       }
+       
+       // 当前月的日期
+       for (let i = 1; i <= daysInMonth; i++) {
+         const dateString = this.formatDate(new Date(year, month - 1, i));
+         
+         week.push({
+           day: i,
+           date: new Date(year, month - 1, i),
+           dateString: dateString,
+           isCurrentMonth: true,
+           isToday: dateString === this.data.today,
+           isSelected: this.isDateSelected(dateString),
+           isInRange: this.isDateInRange(dateString)
+         });
+         
+         // 每7天为一行
+         if (week.length === 7) {
+           days.push(week);
+           week = [];
+         }
+       }
+       
+       // 下个月的日期填充
+       if (week.length > 0) {
+         const remainingCells = 7 - week.length;
+         
+         for (let i = 1; i <= remainingCells; i++) {
+           const nextMonth = month + 1 <= 12 ? month + 1 : 1;
+           const nextYear = month + 1 <= 12 ? year : year + 1;
+           const dateString = this.formatDate(new Date(nextYear, nextMonth - 1, i));
+           
+           week.push({
+             day: i,
+             date: new Date(nextYear, nextMonth - 1, i),
+             dateString: dateString,
+             isCurrentMonth: false,
+             isToday: dateString === this.data.today,
+             isSelected: this.isDateSelected(dateString),
+             isInRange: this.isDateInRange(dateString)
+           });
+         }
+         
+         days.push(week);
+       }
+       
+       // 确保日历总是显示6行
+       while (days.length < 6) {
+         let week = [];
+         const nextMonth = month + 1 <= 12 ? month + 1 : 1;
+         const nextYear = month + 1 <= 12 ? year : year + 1;
+         
+         for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
+           const day = days.length * 7 - firstDayOfWeek + i + 1 - daysInMonth;
+           if (day > 0) {
+             const dateString = this.formatDate(new Date(nextYear, nextMonth - 1, day));
+             
+             week.push({
+               day: day,
+               date: new Date(nextYear, nextMonth - 1, day),
+               dateString: dateString,
+               isCurrentMonth: false,
+               isToday: dateString === this.data.today,
+               isSelected: this.isDateSelected(dateString),
+               isInRange: this.isDateInRange(dateString)
+             });
+           } else {
+             week.push({});
+           }
+         }
+         
+         days.push(week);
+       }
+       
+       this.setData({
+         calendarDays: days
+       });
+     },
+     
+     /**
+      * 检查日期是否被选中
+      */
+     isDateSelected: function(dateString) {
+       return this.data.selectedDatesInternal.includes(dateString);
+     },
+     
+     /**
+      * 检查日期是否在选择范围内
+      */
+     isDateInRange: function(dateString) {
+       if (!this.data.dateRange.start || !this.data.dateRange.end) {
+         return false;
+       }
+       
+       const date = new Date(dateString);
+       const start = new Date(this.data.dateRange.start);
+       const end = new Date(this.data.dateRange.end);
+       
+       return date >= start && date <= end;
+     },
+     
+     /**
+      * 日期格式化为 yyyy-MM-dd
+      */
+     formatDate: function(date) {
+       const year = date.getFullYear();
+       const month = (date.getMonth() + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0');
+       const day = date.getDate().toString().padStart(2, '0');
+       
+       return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
+     },
+     
+     /**
+      * 格式化显示日期（如：2025年5月10日）
+      */
+     formatDisplayDate: function(dateString) {
+       if (!dateString) return '';
+       
+       const date = new Date(dateString);
+       const year = date.getFullYear();
+       const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
+       const day = date.getDate();
+       
+       return `${year}年${month}月${day}日`;
+     },
+     
+     /**
+      * 获取所选星期几的名称
+      */
+     getWeekdayNames: function() {
+       if (!this.data.selectedDatesInternal || this.data.selectedDatesInternal.length === 0) {
+         return '';
+       }
+       
+       // 获取唯一的星期几
+       const weekdays = [...new Set(this.data.selectedDatesInternal.map(
+         dateString => new Date(dateString).getDay()
+       ))];
+       
+       // 转换为中文星期名称
+       const weekdayNames = ['周日', '周一', '周二', '周三', '周四', '周五', '周六'];
+       return weekdays.map(day => weekdayNames[day]).join('、');
+     },
+     
+     /**
+      * 上个月
+      */
+     prevMonth: function() {
+       let year = this.data.currentYear;
+       let month = this.data.currentMonth - 1;
+       
+       if (month < 1) {
+         month = 12;
+         year -= 1;
+       }
+       
+       this.setData({
+         currentYear: year,
+         currentMonth: month
+       });
+       
+       this.generateCalendarDays(year, month);
+     },
+     
+     /**
+      * 下个月
+      */
+     nextMonth: function() {
+       let year = this.data.currentYear;
+       let month = this.data.currentMonth + 1;
+       
+       if (month > 12) {
+         month = 1;
+         year += 1;
+       }
+       
+       this.setData({
+         currentYear: year,
+         currentMonth: month
+       });
+       
+       this.generateCalendarDays(year, month);
+     },
+     
+     /**
+      * 单击选择/取消选择日期
+      */
+     toggleDateSelection: function(e) {
+       const dateString = e.currentTarget.dataset.date;
+       
+       // 检查是否是过去的日期
+       const selectedDate = new Date(dateString);
+       const today = new Date(this.data.today);
+       
+       // 不允许选择过去的日期
+       if (selectedDate < today) {
+         wx.showToast({
+           title: '不能选择过去的日期',
+           icon: 'none'
+         });
+         return;
+       }
+       
+       // 如果是单选模式或者没有选中日期
+       if (this.data.cycleMode === 'none' || this.data.selectedDatesInternal.length === 0) {
+         // 如果已经选中了该日期，则取消选择
+         if (this.isDateSelected(dateString)) {
+           this.setData({
+             selectedDatesInternal: this.data.selectedDatesInternal.filter(d => d !== dateString),
+             quickOption: '', // 清除快捷选择状态
+             cycleMode: 'none' // 清除周期模式
+           });
+         } else {
+           // 设置为单选模式
+           this.setData({
+             selectedDatesInternal: [dateString],
+             dateRange: {
+               start: dateString,
+               end: dateString
+             },
+             quickOption: 'custom', // 设置为自定义模式
+             cycleMode: 'none' // 清除周期模式
+           });
+         }
+       } 
+       // 多选模式下
+       else {
+         // 获取最早和最晚的日期来确定范围
+         let dates = [...this.data.selectedDatesInternal];
+         
+         // 如果已经选中了该日期，则取消选择
+         if (this.isDateSelected(dateString)) {
+           dates = dates.filter(d => d !== dateString);
+         } else {
+           dates.push(dateString);
+         }
+         
+         // 如果没有选中日期，则清除范围
+         if (dates.length === 0) {
+           this.setData({
+             selectedDatesInternal: [],
+             dateRange: { start: '', end: '' },
+             quickOption: '',
+             cycleMode: 'none'
+           });
+         } else {
+           // 排序日期以获取范围
+           dates.sort();
+           
+           this.setData({
+             selectedDatesInternal: dates,
+             dateRange: {
+               start: dates[0],
+               end: dates[dates.length - 1]
+             },
+             cycleMode: 'custom' // 设置为自定义模式
+           });
+         }
+       }
+       
+       // 更新日历显示
+       this.generateCalendarDays(this.data.currentYear, this.data.currentMonth);
+       
+       // 触发事件
+       this.triggerSelectionChangeEvent();
+     },
+     
+     /**
+      * 开始选择范围
+      */
+     startRangeSelection: function(e) {
+       const dateString = e.currentTarget.dataset.date;
+       
+       // 检查是否是过去的日期
+       const selectedDate = new Date(dateString);
+       const today = new Date(this.data.today);
+       
+       // 不允许选择过去的日期
+       if (selectedDate < today) {
+         wx.showToast({
+           title: '不能选择过去的日期',
+           icon: 'none'
+         });
+         return;
+       }
+       
+       // 震动反馈
+       wx.vibrateShort({ type: 'medium' });
+       
+       this.setData({
+         isSelectingRange: true,
+         dateRange: {
+           start: dateString,
+           end: dateString
+         },
+         cycleMode: 'custom', // 设置为自定义模式
+         quickOption: 'custom' // 设置为自定义选择
+       });
+       
+       // 更新选中的日期
+       this.updateSelectedDatesFromRange();
+     },
+     
+     /**
+      * 更新选择范围
+      */
+     updateRangeSelection: function(e) {
+       if (!this.data.isSelectingRange) return;
+       
+       // 获取触摸点坐标对应的日期单元格
+       const touch = e.touches[0];
+       const node = this.getDateNodeFromTouch(touch);
+       
+       if (node && node.dataset && node.dataset.date) {
+         const dateString = node.dataset.date;
+         const date = new Date(dateString);
+         const today = new Date(this.data.today);
+         
+         // 不允许选择过去的日期
+         if (date < today) {
+           return;
+         }
+         
+         if (this.data.dateRange.end !== dateString) {
+           // 更新结束日期
+           this.setData({
+             'dateRange.end': dateString
+           });
+           
+           // 更新选中的日期
+           this.updateSelectedDatesFromRange();
+           
+           // 更新日历显示
+           this.generateCalendarDays(this.data.currentYear, this.data.currentMonth);
+         }
+       }
+     },
+     
+     /**
+      * 根据触摸坐标获取日期单元格
+      * 注意：这是一个模拟实现，在实际项目中可能需要使用wx.createSelectorQuery()来获取精确的元素
+      */
+     getDateNodeFromTouch: function(touch) {

+       return new Promise((resolve) => {

+           }
+           
+           const cells = rects[0];

+         while (current <= end) {
```

```diff
      /**
-      * 选择执行日期
+      * 处理统一日历选择器日期选择变更
+      */
+     onDateSelectionChange: function(e) {
+       console.log('统一日历选择变更:', e.detail);
+       const { selectedDates, isMultiple, cycleMode, dateRange, taskMode } = e.detail;
+       
+       if (taskMode === 'once') {
+         // 一次性任务，只取第一个日期
+         if (selectedDates && selectedDates.length > 0) {
+           this.triggerEvent('dateChange', { date: selectedDates[0] });
+         }
+       } else {
+         // 周期性任务，处理多个日期
+         const repeatData = {
+           selectedDates: selectedDates,
+           cycleMode: cycleMode,
+           startDate: dateRange.start || '',
+           endDate: dateRange.end || ''
+         };
+         
+         // 根据周期模式设置重复类型
+         let repeatType = 'custom';
+         if (cycleMode === 'daily') {
+           repeatType = 'daily';
+         } else if (cycleMode === 'workdays') {
+           repeatType = 'workdays';
+         } else if (cycleMode === 'weekly') {
+           repeatType = 'weekly';
+         }
+         
+         // 更新重复日期
+         this.triggerEvent('startDateChange', { date: dateRange.start });
+         this.triggerEvent('endDateChange', { date: dateRange.end });
+         this.triggerEvent('frequencyChange', { type: repeatType });
+         this.triggerEvent('selectedDatesChange', { selectedDates });
+         
+         // 如果是周模式，计算每周哪几天
+         if (cycleMode === 'weekly' && selectedDates.length > 0) {
+           const dayIndices = selectedDates.map(dateString => 
+             new Date(dateString).getDay()
+           );
+           // 周日为0，周一为1，...周六为6
+           this.triggerEvent('daysChange', { days: [...new Set(dayIndices)] });
+         }
+       }
+       
+       // 如果有周期模式变更，触发模式变更事件
+       if (this.properties.repeatMode !== taskMode) {
+         this.triggerEvent('modeChange', { mode: taskMode });
+       }
+     },
```
